title: tonningia angusta
intro: Tonningia angusta, commonly known as the "Chinese Aristolochia", is a plant species that belongs to the Aristolochiaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include being used to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Tonningia angusta are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain, and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include aristolochic acid, which is responsible for its medicinal properties, although it should be used with caution due to potential side effects.
